verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَـٰتِ ذَرْوًا

translations.text: By those [winds] that scatter far and wide,
Kasam hai un hawaon ki jo gard (dust) udane wali hain

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱلْحَـٰمِلَـٰتِ وِقْرًا

translations.text: and those that are heavily laden,
Phir pani se ladeh huey badal uthane wali hain

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱلْجَـٰرِيَـٰتِ يُسْرًا

translations.text: that speed freely,
Phir subuk raftari (smoothly speed along) ke saath chalne wali hain

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَـٰتِ أَمْرًا

translations.text: that distribute [rain] as ordained!
Phir ek baday kaam (barish) ki taqseem karne wali hain

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ

translations.text: What you [people] are promised is true:
Haqq yeh hai ke jis cheez ka tumhein khauf dilaya ja raha hai woh sacchi hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ

translations.text: the Judgement will come––
Aur jazaa-e-aamal (recompense) zaroor pesh aani hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ

translations.text: by the sky with its pathways,
Kasam hai muttafarriq shakalon(numerous forms) waley aasmaan ki

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ

translations.text: you differ in what you say––
(Aakhirat ke barey mein) tumhari baat ek durse se mukhtalif hai

verses.text_uthmani: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ

translations.text: those who turn away from it are [truly] deceived.
Ussey wahi bargashta (deluded/averse) hota hai jo haqq se phira hua hai

verses.text_uthmani: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ

translations.text: Perish the liars,
Maarey gaye qayas-o-gumaan (conjecturers) se hukum lagane wale

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ

translations.text: those steeped in error and unaware!
Jo jihalat(ignorance) mein garq aur gaflat mein madhosh hain

verses.text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ

translations.text: They ask, ‘When is this Judgement Day coming?’
Puchte hain aakhir woh roz-e-jaza kab aayega

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ

translations.text: On a Day when they will be punished by the Fire,
Woh us roz aayega jab yeh log aag par tapaye jayenge

verses.text_uthmani: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

translations.text: ‘Taste the punishment! This is what you wished to hasten.’
(Insey kaha jayega) ab chakkho maza apne fitne ka, yeh wahi cheez hai jiske liye tum jaldi macha rahey thay

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

translations.text: The righteous will be in Gardens with [flowing] springs.
Albatta muttaqi log us roz baaghon(gardens) aur chashmo (fountains) mein hongey

verses.text_uthmani: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ

translations.text: They will receive their Lord’s gifts because of the good they did before:
Jo kuch unka Rubb unhein dega usey khushi khushi le rahey hongey. Woh us din ke aane se pehle neikukar (doers of good) thay

verses.text_uthmani: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ

translations.text: sleeping only little at night,
Raaton(nights) ko kam hi sotey(sleep) thay

verses.text_uthmani: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ

translations.text: praying at dawn for God’s forgiveness,
Phir wahi raat ke pichle peharon mein maafi maangte thay

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ

translations.text: giving a rightful share of their wealth to the beggar and the deprived.
Aur unke maalon(wealth) mein haqq tha saahil( maangne waley) aur mehroom(destitute) ke liye

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ

translations.text: On earth there are signs for those with sure faith––
Zameen mein bahut si nishaniyan hain yaqeen laney walon ke liye

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ

translations.text: and in yourselves too, do you not see?––
Aur khud tumhare apne wajood mein hain, kya tumko soojhta nahin

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ

translations.text: in the sky is your sustenance and all that you are promised.
Aasman hi mein hai tumhara rizq bhi aur woh cheez bhi jiska tumse waada kiya ja raha hai

verses.text_uthmani: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ

translations.text: By the Lord of the heavens and earth! All this is as real as your speaking.
Pas kasam hai aasmaan aur zameen ke maalik ki, yeh baat haqq hai, aisi hi yaqeeni jaise tum bol rahey ho

verses.text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ

translations.text: [Muhammad], have you heard the story of the honoured guests of Abraham?
Aey Nabi, Ibrahim ke muazzaz mehmano ki hiqayat bhi tumhein pahunchi hai

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ

translations.text: They went in to see him and said, ‘Peace.’ ‘Peace,’ he said, [adding to himself] ‘These people are strangers.’
Jab woh uske haan (yahan) aaye to kaha aapko salaam hai. Usne kaha “ aap logon ko bhi salaam hai kuch na-aashna se log hain”

verses.text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ

translations.text: He turned quickly to his household, brought out a fat calf,
Phir woh chupke se apne ghar walon ke paas gaya, aur ek mota taaza bachda (calf) laa kar

verses.text_uthmani: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ

translations.text: and placed it before them. ‘Will you not eat?’ he said,
Mehmanon ke aage pesh kiya. Usne kaha aap hazraat khate nahin

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ

translations.text: beginning to be afraid of them, but they said, ‘Do not be afraid.’ They gave him good news of a son who would be gifted with knowledge.
Phir woh apne dil mein unse dara. Unhon ne kaha dariye nahin, aur usey ek zee-ilm ladke ki paidaish ka mushda (good news/basharat) sunaya

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ

translations.text: His wife then entered with a loud cry, struck her face, and said, ‘A barren old woman?’
Yeh sunkar uski biwi cheekhti hui aage badhi aur usne apna mooh peeth liya aur kehne lagi, “boodhi baanj”

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

translations.text: but they said, ‘It will be so. This is what your Lord said, and He is the Wise, the All Knowing.’
Unhon ne kaha “yahi kuch farmaya hai tere Rubb ne. Woh hakeem hai aur sab kuch jaanta hai

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

translations.text: Abraham said, ‘What is your errand, messengers?’
Ibrahim ne kaha “aey farstaadgaan-e-ilaahi (envoys), kya mohim aapko dar-pesh hai

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ

translations.text: They said, ‘We are sent to a people lost in sin,
Unhon ne kaha “hum ek mujrim qaum ki taraf bheje gaye hain

verses.text_uthmani: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ

translations.text: to bring down rocks of clay,
Taa-ke uspar paki hui mitti ke patthar (clay-stones) barsa de

verses.text_uthmani: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ

translations.text: marked by your Lord for those who exceed all bounds.’
Jo aapke Rubb ke haan hadd se guzar jane walon ke liye nishan zada hain”

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.text: We brought out such believers as were there-
Phir humne un sab logon ko nikal liya jo us basti mein momin thay

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ

translations.text: We found only one household devoted to God-
Aur wahan humne ek ghar ke siwa musalmano ka koi ghar na paya

verses.text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ

translations.text: and left the town to be a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
Uske baad humne wahan bas ek nishani un logon ke liye chodh di jo dardnaak azaab se darte hon

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

translations.text: There is another sign in Moses: We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
Aur (tumhare liye nishani hai) Moosa ke qissey mein jab humne usey sareeh sanad (clear authority) ke saath Firoun ke paas bheja

verses.text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَـٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ

translations.text: Pharaoh turned away with his supporters, saying, ‘This is a sorcerer, or maybe a madman,’
To woh apne bal-bootay par akad gaya aur bola yeh jaadugar hai ya majnoon(deewana) hai

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ

translations.text: so We seized him and his forces and threw them into the sea: he was to blame.
Aakhir-e-kaar humne usey aur uske lashkaron ko pakda aur sabko samandar mein phenk diya aur woh malamat zadah hokar reh gaya

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ

translations.text: There is another sign in the Ad: We sent the life-destroying wind against them
Aur (tumhare liye nishani hai) Aad (people of Aad) mein, jabke humne unpar ek aisi hi bay-khair(devastating) hawa bhej di

verses.text_uthmani: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ

translations.text: and it reduced everything it came up against to shreds.
Ke jis cheez par bhi woh guzar gayi usey boseeda (rotten) karke rakh diya

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ

translations.text: And also in the Thamud: it was said to them, ‘Make the most of your lives for a while,’
Aur (tumhare liye nishani hai) Samood mein, jab unse kaha gaya tha ke ek khaas waqt tak mazey karlo

verses.text_uthmani: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ

translations.text: but they rebelled against their Lord’s command, so the blast took them. They looked on helplessly:
Magar is tambeeh(warning) par bhi unhon ne apne Rubb ke hukum se sartabi (brazenly disobey) ki. Aakhir-e-kar unke dekhte dekhte ek achanak toot padne waley azaab ne unko aa liya

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ

translations.text: they could not even remain standing, let alone defend themselves.
Phir na unmein uthne ki sakat thi aur na woh apna bachao kar sakte thay

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ

translations.text: Before that We destroyed the people of Noah. They were a truly sinful people!
Aur in sabse pehle humne Nooh ki qaum ko halaak kiya kyunke woh fasiq (wicked) log thay

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ

translations.text: We built the heavens with Our power and made them vast,
Aasman ko humne apne zoar se banaya hai aur hum iski qudrat rakhte hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَـٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَـٰهِدُونَ

translations.text: We spread out the earth- how well We smoothed it out!-
Zameen ko humne bichaya hai aur hum badey acchey hamwar(Smoothers/ spread) karne waley hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ

translations.text: and We created pairs of all things so that you [people] might take note.
Aur har cheez ke humne jodey banaye hain, shayad ke tum ussey sabaq lo

verses.text_uthmani: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.text: [So, say to them, Prophet], ‘Quickly, turn to God- I am sent by Him to give you clear warning-
To daudo Allah ki taraf , main tumahre liye us ki taraf se saaf saaf khabardar karne wala hoon

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.text: and do not set up any other god alongside Him. I am sent by Him to give you clear warning!’
Aur na banao Allah ke saath koi dusra mabood. Main tumahre liye uski taraf se saaf saaf khabardar karne wala hoon

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ

translations.text: Every previous people to whom a messenger was sent also said, ‘A sor-cerer, or maybe a madman!’
Yunhi hota raha hai, inse pehle ki qaumon ke paas bhi koi Rasool aisa nahin aaya jisey unhon ne yeh na kaha ho ke yeh saahir (sorcerer) hai ya majnoon(deewana)

verses.text_uthmani: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ

translations.text: Did they tell one another to do this? No! They are a people who exceed all bounds,
Kya in sab ne apas mein ispar koi samjhauta karliya hai? Nahin, balke yeh sab sarkash log hain

verses.text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍ

translations.text: so ignore them [Prophet]- you are not to blame-
Pas aey Nabi, inse rukh pher lo, tumpar kuch malamat nahin

verses.text_uthmani: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.text: and go on reminding [people], it is good for those who believe to be reminded.
Albatta nasihat karte raho, kyunke nasihat imaan laney walon ke liye nafeh(faiyda-mand) hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ

translations.text: I created jinn and mankind only to worship Me:
Maine Jinn aur Insano ko iske siwa kisi kaam ke liye paida nahin kiya hai ke woh meri bandagi karein

verses.text_uthmani: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ

translations.text: I want no provision from them, nor do I want them to feed Me-
Main unsey koi rizq nahin chahta aur na yeh chahta hoon ke woh mujhey khilayein

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ

translations.text: God is the Provider, the Lord of Power, the Ever Mighty.
Allah to khud hi Razzak hai, badi quwwat wala aur zabardast

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَـٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ

translations.text: The evildoers, like their predecessors, will have a share of punishment- they need not ask Me to hasten it-
Pas jin logon ne zulm kiya hai unke hissey ka bhi waisa hi azaab tayyar hai jaisa inhi jaise logon ko unke hissey ka mil chuka hai, iske liye yeh log jaldi na machayein

verses.text_uthmani: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ

translations.text: and woe betide those who deny the truth on the Day they have been promised.
Aakhir ko tabahi hai kufr karne walon ke liye us roz jiska inhein khauff dilaya jaa raha hai
